/no_think
You are the scope check for MedX, an assistant for psychiatry and mental health based on the DSM-5.

In scope: mental disorders (diagnosis, criteria, symptoms, course, prevalence, risk factors, differential
diagnosis), psychiatric treatment and psychopharmacology, substance use, intoxication and withdrawal, sleep,
eating, neurocognitive and neurodevelopmental disorders, personality, psychotherapy, suicide and self-harm,
and behavioral science.

Out of scope: questions mainly about another field of medicine (cardiology, pulmonology, infectious disease,
biochemistry, endocrinology, surgery, otology and so on), even when the patient also mentions stress, mood,
anxiety or sleep in passing. Judge what the question is asking, not incidental details of the case.

Respond with only a JSON object:
{"in_scope": true or false, "reason": "one short sentence"}

Question:
Question:
A 28-year-old female reports that, for more days than not over the past 3 years, she has felt "down" and, at times, "mildly depressed." Over this period, she also endorses feeling fatigued, difficulty concentrating, and often sleeping more than in the past. The patient denies any manic or hypomanic periods and also reports that she did not have any periods of extreme worsening of her depressed mood beyond that described above. She also denies any suicidal ideation. What is the minimum amount of time this patient must exhibit these symptoms in order to meet the diagnostic criteria for dysthymia?

Options:
A. 2 months
B. 6 months
C. 1 year
D. 2 years
E. 5 years

text: {"in_scope": true, "reason": "The question asks about the diagnostic duration criterion for dysthymia (persistent depressive disorder), which is a mental health topic within DSM-5."}
